description: A twilight exterior of a contemporary two-story residence viewed head-on from the driveway. The house features a flat roofline with deep overhangs, a matte grey and charcoal stucco facade, and large black-framed floor-to-ceiling windows on both levels. A glass-railed upper balcony stretches across the second floor. Interior warm amber light glows from within, visible through the full-width glazed openings. A wide concrete driveway leads to a pair of matte black horizontal-slat double entry gates set between two white stucco columns with flat caps. Tall columnar cypress-style evergreen trees flank both sides of the gates. Low clipped boxwood hedges line the perimeter. A black mailbox and a security intercom panel are mounted to the gate pillars. The sky is a dramatic overcast blue-grey, creating a dusk mood. Warm directional light washes down each gate column from above, highlighting the textured stucco surface. The mood is sleek, modern, and architecturally assertive.
